description: Empirical efficiency-vs-deltaT lookup for a Bi2Te3 TEG module (ZT~1). Conversion efficiency eta = eta_carnot * gamma, where gamma=(sqrt(1+ZT)-1)/(sqrt(1+ZT)+Tc/Th). Table tabulated at T_cold=30C.
source: Rowe (2006) Thermoelectrics Handbook; Snyder & Toberer (2008), Nature Materials, 7, 105-114

ZT.note: Average ZT for Bi2Te3 (reused from EC216 F1a)

T_cold_ref.note: Reference cold-side temperature for the lookup table

alpha_seebeck.note: Seebeck coefficient per couple (reused from F1a)

R_internal.note: Internal resistance per module at matched load (reused from F1a)

lookup.note: Breakpoints: hot-side temperature (degC) -> module conversion efficiency (fraction), cold side fixed at 30C

efficiency.note: Rated efficiency ~7.2% at 200C/30C for ZT=1 Bi2Te3 (Carnot x ZT reduction factor)
